Lead brand positioning, lifecycle management and portfolio optimization across therapy areas to maximize growth and profitability. Act as a strategic partner to the Sales leadership and field force, ensuring strong alignment between marketing initiatives and on-ground execution. Identify, engage and manage relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and key external stakeholders to strengthen brand advocacy and medical credibility. Drive pricing strategy reviews in collaboration with Sales and Finance, factoring competitive dynamics, affordability and margin objectives. Continuously monitor market trends, customer needs, competitive activity and regional performance, providing actionable insights and course corrections. Design and deliver regional training programs to build product, scientific and commercial capability within the field force. Oversee regional marketing analytics, including primary and secondary sales analysis and present structured performance dashboards to senior stakeholders. High level of independence, resilience and ownership mindset. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical and decision-making skills. Prior experience in Africa or frontier markets will be a strong advantage. Why Join Us ? Be part of a fast-growing, mission-led organization transforming healthcare access in Africa. Work alongside passionate teams with deep expertise and purpose. Gain exposure to cross-cultural operations, strategic growth projects and innovation opportunities. Application : If this role is of interest to you, please upload a recent copy of your CV and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will be in touch. We believe that equal opportunities mean inclusion, diversity and fair treatment for all.

review_candidates.title: Associate Director/Director - East and Southern Africa
review_candidates.description: Kenya Associate Director/Director - East and Southern Africa Organization IDinsight Posted 22 Sep 2026 Closing date 9 Oct 2026 About IDinsight We're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and non-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most impact. IDinsight is a mission-driven global advisory, data analytics, and research organization that helps global development leaders maximize their social impact. We tailor a wide range of data and evidence tools, including randomized evaluations and machine learning, to help decision-makers design effective programs and rigorously test what works to support communities. We work with governments, multilateral agencies, foundations, and innovative non-profit organizations in Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors, including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other areas. We Have Expertise In a Variety Of Rigorous Approaches And Methodologies, Which We Tailor To Each Client Depending On Their Needs And Constraints. To Achieve a Positive Social Impact We Support clients’ use of data and evidence for routine and major decision-making. Inform funding decisions – toward high-impact initiatives and away from less effective programs or approaches. Create and share tools, knowledge, and ideas that expand the use of data and evidence for social good. Our diverse, growing team of roughly 240 outstanding colleagues operates in nearly two dozen countries around the world. Learn more about our mission and values at www.IDinsight.org . About The Associate Director & Director Role The Associate Director/Director will report to the Regional Director and will be supported by other Directors in the Region and IDinsight’s CEO. The Director will help drive major parts of IDinsight’s work and strategy in the Region. The Director will be supported by high-quality research teams, an excellent operations team that ensures a well-functioning organisation, and a communications team to help amplify the Director’s voice in policy circles. They will also be provided with bi-annual performance reviews (including feedback from peers and direct reports) to help them continuously grow and learn as professionals. The Director will be provided with significant autonomy to leverage IDinsight as a platform to drive social impact (in accordance with our mission and strategy), while also being held accountable for the clear goals they set for themselves, in consultation with the Regional Director and other leaders at IDinsight. Role Each Director role at IDinsight is unique and tailored to the strengths of specific individuals. However, at a high level, this role will include: Develop and lead high-impact opportunities: Building on their experience, expertise, and networks, the Director will help conceptualise, secure, fundraise for, and execute high-impact initiatives that use data and evidence to drive change. All initiatives should be in line with IDinsight’s mission and strategy, but can take various forms, ranging from direct client-service engagements to amplifying our partners’ impact, contributing to public knowledge products aimed at infusing data and evidence into important social sector debates. Lead, mentor, and guide project teams: Project leadership involves liaising with senior clients regularly, ensuring the highest standards of research quality and ethics, overseeing and mentoring teams (usually 3-5 Managers, with 10-15 members in total), ensuring a safe and enabling atmosphere for colleagues, and keeping within project budgets. Most importantly, Directors are expected to set and drive their projects toward achieving social impact. Be a thought leader, a trusted advisor, and an advocate for data-driven reforms: In addition to leading projects, Directors will be expected to apply their considerable experience, expertise, and skills to shape evidence-informed action within one or multiple sectors, regions, or specialisations. This includes writing for leading newspapers and journals, speaking at important conferences, leveraging relationships and networks within the impact community to develop trusted advisory roles with senior leaders, and participating in consultative councils within governments, foundations, and/or non-profits. Contribute to IDinsight strategy: Alongside other senior leaders, the Director will support the Regional Director, working with regional and global leadership teams to craft, refine, and execute IDinsight’s strategy in the region. Support organisational development: The Director will also contribute to global and regional operations, including recruitment, onboarding, and performance reviews. They will be expected to support IDinsight to remain an impact-first, values-based, and nimble organisation even as we grow. Exemplify IDinsight’s mission and values: Ensuring strong alignment between incoming Directors and IDinsight’s values is a priority for us. Directors are the face of IDinsight, both externally and internally, and will be expected to consistently and unambiguously exemplify our mission and values. This position will likely include a good amount of domestic and international travel. Qualifications We are looking for leaders who demonstrate: Deep passion for development and social impact, and strong alignment with IDinsight’s vision and mission; Record of building strong stakeholder and client relationships, especially with governments, Foundations, and non-profits in the Record of impactful thought leadership and advocacy around important social and/or technical issues; Fluency in the role of data and evidence tools – such as impact evaluations, representative surveys, monitoring systems, and/or machine learning – to create insights and impact; Ability to be an inspiring leader in a dynamic, multicultural, and values-based environment; Attitude to thrive in an entrepreneurial setting, and be able to adapt to dynamic growth and change; Eagerness to be a lifelong learner with keen intellectual curiosity and a sense of humour; Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Willingness to travel as needed and to work with remote colleagues; 10+ years’ experience using data and evidence to improve social impact; An advanced degree (Master’s or Doctoral), preferably in public policy, economics, public administration, international development, business, or public health; Excitement to work across multiple development sectors. We understand that no one candidate will be able to excel in all these attributes. Instead, we are looking for leaders who excel in certain attributes while meeting a minimum threshold in all attributes. IDinsight is growing and evolving quickly. We may suggest other suitable roles to candidates who apply, based on the overlap between IDinsight’s needs and candidates’ experience and qualifications. Professional development Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long-term impact strategy and have been noted as highlights of teammates’ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership and support from talented peers and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real-time feedback is embedded in our culture, and a formal structure enables maximum professional growth. Additionally, teammates have access to an annual professional development stipend, which they are encouraged to use to explore their career interests and develop their skills. Nuts & bolts Location This position will be based in our Nairobi office. It is not eligible for remote work. Start date This position will start in October/November 2026 , with a preference for candidates who can start immediately. We expect a two-year minimum commitment, regular professional development conversations, and the potential for a long-term career at IDinsight. Compensation & Benefits Compensation and benefits are commensurate with the qualifications and experiences IDinsight is hiring for and are competitive within the global development sector. We are especially proud of our people-focused benefits, including comprehensive international health insurance, mental health coverage, paid vacation, sick and parental leave, relocation benefits, a travel stipend, technology and work-from-home stipends, a professional development budget, and more. Please note that, as a non-profit, we cannot provide compensation comparable to that of leading private-sector organisations. Work Authorization IDinsight will prioritise candidates who have work authorisation. How to apply The application will ask various questions to get to know you and will require a CV and cover letter. Please note that only candidates selected for the interview will be contacted. Please ensure that your CV includes relevant professional and personal experience, as well as details of academic qualifications. CVs can range from one to two pages. Please note that headshot photographs, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and other personal information not relevant to the application do not need to be included in your CV. Additionally, we strongly encourage you to use your cover letter to highlight why you want to work for IDinsight specifically and what has prepared you to succeed in the role you’re applying for. A customised cover letter is an important part of IDinsight’s recruiting process, as it allows us to understand your motivations for the position, relevant skills, and writing clarity. More information, including details on IDinsight’s hiring process and frequently asked questions , is available on IDinsight Careers . Any questions should be directed to careers@IDinsight.org. review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Company: CAMEL Creatives FZ LLC Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role CAMEL Creatives is looking for a highly organized and proactive Accountant – Accounts Receivable & Finance Operations to manage the company’s day-to-day accounting, invoicing, collections, bookkeeping, and financial documentation. This role is not limited to bookkeeping. A major part of the position involves actively monitoring client payments, following up on outstanding balances, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring all company transactions are properly documented. The successful candidate will work closely with management, clients, suppliers, and CAMEL’s external Tax Agent/accounting firm. Key Responsibilities Invoicing & Accounts Receivable Prepare and issue client Tax Invoices, Invoices, Proforma Invoices, Credit Notes, and Payment Vouchers. Send invoices, Proforma Invoices, contracts, and related financial documents to clients. Maintain an accurate and updated Accounts Receivable tracker. Monitor all outstanding and overdue client payments. Follow up with clients professionally through email, phone calls, and other approved communication channels. Obtain clear payment dates and updates from clients. Confirm received payments and update records immediately. Prepare and maintain client Statements of Account. Escalate significantly delayed payments to management. Bookkeeping & QuickBooks Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records using QuickBooks. Record company income and expenses. Categorize transactions accurately. Record supplier invoices, bills, and payments. Maintain proper supporting documentation for every financial transaction. Ensure all accounting entries are supported by invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, or other required documents. Bank & Expense Reconciliation Regularly review company bank statements. Match bank transactions against invoices, expenses, supplier payments, and supporting documents. Perform regular bank reconciliations. Identify transactions without proper supporting invoices or receipts. Follow up internally with relevant team members to collect missing documents. Monitor outstanding supplier payments and upcoming financial obligations. VAT & Tax Preparation Support Maintain records in accordance with UAE accounting and VAT requirements. Ensure supplier Tax Invoices contain the necessary information before recording them. Maintain proper records of input and output VAT. Prepare accounting records and supporting documentation for CAMEL’s external Tax Agent. Coordinate with the external Tax Agent for VAT returns, Corporate Tax requirements, and financial reviews. Assist in providing any documents requested for VAT, Corporate Tax, audits, or financial reporting. Note: VAT and Corporate Tax filing will remain under the responsibility of CAMEL’s external Tax Agent/accounting firm. Reporting Provide management with regular financial updates, including: Total outstanding client receivables Overdue payments Payments collected Expected upcoming payments Supplier payments due Missing expense invoices or supporting documents Bank balance and cash position Accounts Receivable aging Any unusual or unresolved transactions Requirements Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 2–4 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably within the UAE. Strong experience with QuickBooks / QuickBooks Online. Strong knowledge of Accounts Receivable, invoicing, bookkeeping, and bank reconciliation. Good understanding of UAE VAT requirements and Tax Invoice documentation. Strong Microsoft Excel skills. Experience dealing directly with clients regarding outstanding payments. Ability to prepare professional financial emails and payment follow-ups. Highly organized and detail-oriented. Strong documentation and filing skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of financial follow-ups. Language Requirements Arabic: Fluent or Native. English: Excellent written and spoken English is mandatory. The candidate must be comfortable communicating professionally with clients in both Arabic and English. Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is: Proactive rather than reactive. Confident following up on delayed payments. Comfortable calling clients regarding outstanding invoices. Organized and disciplined with documentation. Able to maintain accurate financial records with minimal supervision. Strong at follow-up and closing pending financial matters. Professional when dealing with clients and suppliers. Able to identify discrepancies before they become larger accounting issues. Key Performance Indicators – KPIs Performance will be measured based on: Accuracy of accounting records. Timely issuance of invoices and Proforma Invoices. Accuracy of QuickBooks records. Percentage of client payments collected on time. Speed and consistency of overdue payment follow-ups. Number of unresolved transactions or missing supporting documents. Accuracy of bank reconciliations. Proper documentation of company expenses. Timely preparation of records for the external Tax Agent. Accuracy of Accounts Receivable reporting. Responsiveness to management and client financial inquiries. Important This position requires someone who is comfortable with both accounting and client payment collection. Candidates who are only interested in bookkeeping and are not comfortable directly following up with clients regarding overdue payments may not be suitable for this role
